subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains a spelling error.

Grievances cannot be redresed unless they are known.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"redresed"** is misspelled and should be "redressed". (सही करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The company quickly** redressed **the issues raised by the customers.
 
 
 
• **"Redressed"** means to set right or remedy a situation or grievance. (सुधारना)
 
 
• **Example:** The grievances were promptly** redressed** by the new management.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Grievances cannot** (शिकायतें नहीं): Expresses the idea that grievances or complaints cannot be addressed.

 
 
• **Example:** Grievances cannot be ignored if we want to maintain a happy workplace.
 
 
 
• **unless they** (जब तक वे): Sets a condition for something to happen.
 
 
• **Example:** Issues will not be resolved unless they are properly communicated.
 
 
 
• **are known** (ज्ञात हैं): Indicates that something must be known or acknowledged.
 
 
• **Example:** The problems can only be solved if they are known to the authorities.
